reason: Repairs active subscription usage windows that were persisted at midnight by the regression, restoring the purchase-time cadence.
risk: The bulk update can briefly lock matching user_subscriptions rows while it normalizes their quota windows. A historical administrator reset made exactly at midnight cannot be distinguished from the regression's persisted midnight value.
mitigation: It is limited to non-deleted, active, unexpired subscriptions. Each window is reanchored to the existing starts_at cadence, and usage is cleared only when that canonical window has already elapsed; current-window usage is preserved. New code writes manual resets at the operation time and only auto-corrects midnight values that align with the initial, current, previous, or next purchase cadence.
